dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are concentrated in the mid-to-posterior dorsal region. The most prominent annuli feature sharp, high-contrast dark perimeters approximately 10-15 pixels thick, transitioning abruptly to lighter interior gray values. A distinct 'C' shape is visible just posterior to the midline, while closed 'O' geometries form a honeycomb-like cluster towards the tail.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A massive, amorphous high-intensity saturated white region is located on the lower lateral flank, lacking any internal texture or gradient. Smaller, high-intensity pixel clusters are scattered anteriorly towards the neck and on the fore-flipper, exhibiting high spatial density but low geometric regularity.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal 'O' annuli and the centroid of the large lateral high-intensity blob form an irregular, elongated quadrilateral. The interior angles of the triangle formed by the three dorsal-most annuli centroids are approximately 45, 60, and 75 degrees.

other_distinctive_markers: The large, saturated white patch on the lateral flank is exceptionally prominent and unique, contrasting with the highly structured, ring-like pattern across the rest of the dorsal surface.
